reveal_fog_of_war: reveal fog of war on a top-down map around an agent's current position and viewing angle
draw_fog_of_war_line: draw a visibility line on the fog of war mask between two points stopping at walls
bresenham_supercover_line: compute all grid points along a line between two coordinates using the Bresenham supercover algorithm
build_fog_of_war_visualization: build a python module that reveals fog of war on a Habitat top-down map using ray casting
test_bresenham_supercover_line: test the bresenham supercover line function by computing grid points between two endpoints
